WITH ordered_history AS (
    SELECT
        vsh.vehicle_id,
        vsh.vehicle_status,
        vsh.vehicle_status_old,
        vsh.changed_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY vsh.vehicle_id
            ORDER BY vsh.changed_at DESC
        ) AS rn,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN vsh.vehicle_status NOT IN (
                    'ASSIGNED',
                    'PRE-ASSIGNED',
                    'ORDERED',
                    'AWAITING-EVALUATION',
                    'AVAILABLE'
                ) THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vsh.vehicle_id
            ORDER BY vsh.changed_at DESC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS break_count
    FROM pulse.vehicle_status_history vsh
),

eligible_vehicles AS (
    SELECT vehicle_id
    FROM ordered_history
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND vehicle_status IN (
          'AVAILABLE'
      )
),

latest_chain AS (
    SELECT oh.*
    FROM ordered_history oh
    JOIN eligible_vehicles ev
      ON ev.vehicle_id = oh.vehicle_id
    WHERE oh.break_count = 0
),

chain_entry AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (vehicle_id)
        vehicle_id,
        vehicle_status,
        vehicle_status_old,
        changed_at
    FROM latest_chain
    ORDER BY vehicle_id, changed_at ASC
)

SELECT
    v.vrm,
    v.vehicle_source,
    vt.manufacturer,
    vt.model,
    b.branch_name,
    ce.changed_at,
    ce.vehicle_status,
    ce.vehicle_status_old
FROM chain_entry ce
LEFT JOIN pulse.vehicle v
    ON v.id = ce.vehicle_id
LEFT JOIN pulse.vehicle_type vt
    ON vt.id = v.vehicle_type_id
LEFT JOIN pulse.branch b
    ON b.id = v.branch_id
ORDER BY v.vrm;

SELECT
  v.vrm,
  v.vehicle_status,
  v.vehicle_source,

  vt.manufacturer,
  vt.model,

  b.branch_name

  FROM pulse.vehicle v

  LEFT JOIN pulse.vehicle_type vt
    ON vt.id = v.vehicle_type_id

  LEFT JOIN pulse.branch b
    ON b.id = v.physical_branch_id

WHERE vehicle_status IN ('AVAILABLE')

SELECT 

	t.reason,
	t.in_date,

	a.agreement_type,
	a.vehicle_source,

	b.branch_name

FROM pulse.transfer t

LEFT JOIN pulse.agreement a
	ON a.id = t.agreement_id

LEFT JOIN pulse.branch b
	ON a.branch_id = b.id

WHERE t.reason ILIKE '%term%'

WITH agreement_counts AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        COUNT(*) AS agreement_count
    FROM pulse.agreement
    WHERE vehicle_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY vehicle_id
)

SELECT
    -- Application
    a.branch_id,
    b.branch_name,
    a.vehicle_id,
    a.driver_id,
    a.employee_id,
    a.application_type,
    a.application_status,
    a.downpayment_amount,
    a.downpayment_status,
    a.agreement_value_weeks,
    a.agreement_length_weeks,
    a.deposit,
    a.total_due,
    a.vat_value,
    a.vehicle_source,
    a.downpayment_order_id,
    a.final_downpayment_order_id,
    ch.updated_date,

    -- Derived from agreement table
    COALESCE(ac.agreement_count, 0) AS agreement_count,

    -- Vehicle
    v.condition,
    v.used,
    v.vehicle_type_id,
    v.vrm,

    -- Vehicle Type
    vt.manufacturer,
    vt.model

FROM pulse.application a

LEFT JOIN pulse.branch b
    ON a.branch_id = b.id

LEFT JOIN pulse.vehicle v
    ON a.vehicle_id = v.id

LEFT JOIN pulse.vehicle_type vt
    ON v.vehicle_type_id = vt.id

JOIN pulse.charge ch
    ON a.downpayment_order_id = ch.ordway_order_id

LEFT JOIN agreement_counts ac
    ON a.vehicle_id = ac.vehicle_id;

  r2b_returns_cardiff: 0,
  r2b_returns_manchester: 0,
  r2b_returns_shah_manchester: 0,
  r2b_returns_birmingham: 0,

  available_vehicles: 0,
  available_vehicles_kings_mall: 0,
  avg_days_off_road: 0,

  net_rentals: 0,
  net_r2b: 0
};

const mergedByDate = {};

for (const item of items) {
  const row = item.json;

  if (row._fleet !== TARGET_FLEET) continue;
  if (!row.Date) continue;

  if (!mergedByDate[row.Date]) {
    mergedByDate[row.Date] = { ...DEFAULT_ROW, Date: row.Date };
  }

  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(row)) {
    if (key === '_fleet' || key === 'Date') continue;
    mergedByDate[row.Date][key] = value;
  }
}

for (const row of Object.values(mergedByDate)) {
  row.r2b_returns =
    (row.r2b_returns_cardiff || 0) +
    (row.r2b_returns_manchester || 0) +
    (row.r2b_returns_shah_manchester || 0) +
    (row.r2b_returns_birmingham || 0);

  row.net_rentals = (row.rentals_out || 0) - (row.rentals_in || 0);

  row.net_r2b =
    ((row.new_r2b_orders || 0) + (row.used_r2b_orders || 0)) -
    (row.r2b_returns || 0);
}

return Object.values(mergedByDate)
  .sort((a, b) => a.Date.localeCompare(b.Date))
  .map(json => ({ json }));

  row.r2b_returns =
    (row.r2b_returns_cardiff || 0) +
    (row.r2b_returns_manchester || 0) +
    (row.r2b_returns_shah_manchester || 0) +
    (row.r2b_returns_birmingham || 0);

  row.net_rentals = (row.rentals_out || 0) - (row.rentals_in || 0);

  row.net_r2b =
    ((row.new_r2b_orders || 0) + (row.used_r2b_orders || 0)) -
    (row.r2b_returns || 0);
}

return Object.values(mergedByDate)
  .sort((a, b) => a.Date.localeCompare(b.Date))
  .map(json => ({ json }));

parameters.query:
WITH agreement_counts AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        COUNT(*) AS agreement_count
    FROM pulse.agreement
    WHERE vehicle_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY vehicle_id
)

SELECT
    -- Application
    a.branch_id,
    b.branch_name,
    a.vehicle_id,
    a.driver_id,
    a.employee_id,
    a.application_type,
    a.application_status,
    a.downpayment_amount,
    a.downpayment_status,
    a.agreement_value_weeks,
    a.agreement_length_weeks,
    a.deposit,
    a.total_due,
    a.vat_value,
    a.vehicle_source,
    a.downpayment_order_id,
    a.final_downpayment_order_id,
    a.created_date AS reservation_created_date,

    -- Final payment date from charge table
    final_ch.created_date AS final_downpayment_created_date,

    -- Derived from agreement table
    COALESCE(ac.agreement_count, 0) AS agreement_count,

    -- Vehicle
    v.condition,
    v.used,
    v.vehicle_type_id,
    v.vrm,

    -- Vehicle Type
    vt.manufacturer,
    vt.model

FROM pulse.application a

LEFT JOIN pulse.branch b
    ON a.branch_id = b.id

LEFT JOIN pulse.vehicle v
    ON a.vehicle_id = v.id

LEFT JOIN pulse.vehicle_type vt
    ON v.vehicle_type_id = vt.id

LEFT JOIN pulse.charge final_ch
    ON a.final_downpayment_order_id = final_ch.ordway_order_id

LEFT JOIN agreement_counts ac
    ON a.vehicle_id = ac.vehicle_id

WHERE a.downpayment_amount = 99
  AND a.downpayment_status = 'SUCCEEDED';
